title: Technician II Diagnostic Workup Record
description: A structured evidence record for separating observations from hypotheses, ranking differentials, selecting discriminating checks, and documenting bounded conclusions.
instructions: Record direct observations and contextual facts before entering hypotheses.
Keep evidence supporting and contradicting each hypothesis visible.
Document the next check selected because it can change the differential ranking.
Record the authorized action or escalation separately from the diagnostic conclusion.
limitations: This worksheet supports diagnostic reasoning but does not confirm a pathogen, nutrient disorder, genetic cause, or equipment failure by itself.
Use approved site procedures and qualified laboratory or supervisory support when confirmation or restricted actions are required.
